val_network: Shiu et al. 2024 leaky integrate-and-fire on FlyWire v630

_meaning.val_network: Network and model of the engine validation (base model, no MaleCNS extensions).
_meaning.val_neurons: Neurons in the FlyWire v630 network.
_meaning.val_n_stimulated: Stimulated sugar gustatory receptor neurons (the 21 FlyWire IDs of the published example notebook).
_meaning.val_trials_and_duration: [trials, seconds per trial] of every run and of every reference.
_meaning.val_seeds: Poisson input seeds of the engine runs at each rate and refractory setting; references are single unseeded realisations.
_meaning.val_seed_for_figure: Seed whose 30-trial realisation is quoted first and drawn in S1 Fig; ranges are over the three seeds.
_meaning.val_slope_definition: Direction and scale of every regression slope.
_meaning.val_engine_versions: Software versions of the engine runs at 200 and 100 Hz.
_meaning.val_released_default_rate_hz: Poisson rate (Hz) set by default in the released model.py, read from its default_params['r_poi'] when the local Brian2 rerun was started.
_meaning.val_prov_repository_commit: Commit and date of the copy of the published code used here (unmodified).
_meaning.val_prov_notebook_statement: Sentence of the example notebook distributed with the code about the input rate of its first example (the call that writes sugarR.parquet has no rate argument).
_meaning.val_prov_notebook_statement_commit: Date and message of the commit that first stated the 200-Hz default in the notebook.
_meaning.val_prov_model_py_never_200: Whether every committed version of model.py sets r_poi = 150 Hz (two commits, 2023-04-30 and 2023-05-09).
_meaning.val_prov_distributed_output_commit_date: Date of the last commit that changed the distributed sugarR.parquet.
_meaning.val_prov_notebook_output_is_distributed_: Whether the output stored in the notebook of that commit for the call without a rate argument (511,566 spikes; five listed rates of stimulated neurons) equals the distributed sugarR.parquet.
_meaning.val_prov_environment_brian2: Brian2 version in the environment files distributed with the code (brian2=2.5.1, python=3.10, numpy=1.24).
_meaning.val_stim_hz_distributed_sugarR: [min, max, mean] firing rate (Hz) of the 21 stimulated neurons, identified by FlyWire ID, in the distributed sugarR.parquet: the input was 200 Hz, not the 150-Hz default of the released code.
_meaning.val_stim_are_21_highest_distributed_suga: Whether the 21 stimulated neurons are the 21 highest-rate neurons of the distributed sugarR.parquet.
_meaning.val_stim_hz_distributed_sugarR_100Hz: [min, max, mean] firing rate (Hz) of the 21 stimulated neurons in the distributed sugarR_100Hz.parquet (input 100 Hz, as its name says).
_meaning.val_stim_hz_local_brian2_150: [min, max, mean] rate (Hz) of the 21 stimulated neurons in the local Brian2 2.10.1 run at the released default (150 Hz).
_meaning.val_stim_hz_engine_150_discard_seed7: [min, max, mean] rate (Hz) of the 21 stimulated neurons in the engine run at 150 Hz (seed 7, refractory input discarded).
_meaning.val_stim_spikes_per_event: Mean rate of the 21 stimulated neurons in the distributed outputs divided by the nominal input rate (a driven neuron fires slightly less than once per Poisson event).
